events.message: Final Core Production research complete. Makes Autonomous Logistics research available.

researchLog.message: Final Core Production research complete. Makes Autonomous Logistics research available.
End of the World research complete. Unlocks Yin, Yang and Final Core assembly.
Command Robotics research complete. Unlocks Command Robotics recipes and systems.
Mineral Recovery research complete. Unlocks waste buffering, routing and direct Fines recovery.
Precision Control research complete. Unlocks Complex production, Waste Bin, Waste Link, sorting and direct Fines-to-Iron recovery.
Waste Handling research complete. Unlocks waste buffering, routing and direct Fines recovery.
Heavy Robotics research complete. Unlocks Heavy Robotics recipes and systems.
Mythril Refining research complete. Unlocks Mythril Gear and Mythril Wire in the Refiner, Mythril Plate in the Smelter, and the Separator.
Road Channels 2 research complete. Allows three Roads per map face, counting sending and receiving endpoints together.
Ore Separation research complete. Unlocks Ore Separation recipes and systems.

Resource Golem Survey research complete. Allows Bot attacks on four mineral Golems in separate sectors. Iron, Copper and Stone each cost 180 AP. Mythril costs 360 AP. Defeating a Golem creates an infinite mineral reserve with four star connections for Extractors.
Sealed Robotics research complete. Unlocks Sealed Robotics recipes and systems.
Fluid Routing research complete. Unlocks Fluid Routing recipes and systems.
Road Channels 1 research complete. Allows two Roads per map face, counting sending and receiving endpoints together.
Tree Planter research complete. Unlocks the Tree Planter node
Hydraulic Assembly research complete. Unlocks Hydraulic Assembly recipes and systems.
Hydrochemistry research complete. Unlocks Hydrochemistry recipes and systems.
Advanced Fabrication research complete. Unlocks the Assembler II node.

Map Node research complete. Awards 1 Map Point. The first 9 purchases cost 5 Simple. Further Core tiers can enter at purchases 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 as you unlock them. Each new tier starts at 5 of each Core and ramps up over 10 purchases. Prices then rise by 1 of each Core every five purchases until another tier enters.
